authority_claim.mechanism: read-only current-authority gate, then a conditional no-op User UPDATE in the same transaction as the target claim
authority_claim.change_behavior: concurrent demotion, disablement, suspension or deletion matches zero rows and refuses with zero target effect

routes.contract: unique name is the DB arbiter; deterministic target id; actor authority and audit receipt commit with the row; exact replay acknowledges, changed material conflicts; confirmed audit rollback is effect=none
material CAS on current name/permissions/description; unique-name conflict 409; stale target 409; later target revision 503; audit readback and replay reconciliation
conditional delete with NOT EXISTS assigned users and material predicates; in-use/stale conflict; tombstone receipt and exact replay acknowledgement; readback rejects any dangling assignment

unique email DB arbiter; role-existence EXISTS in the insert; generated password hash verified against the authorized password before write; private result digest binds the exact stored hash commitment; unchanged replay already_applied; changed/malformed/deleted credential replay 503 without overwrite

material CAS on email/name/role/status and the exact credential hash; last_login is intentionally excluded so a concurrent login writer is preserved; role-existence EXISTS on role change; stale target 409; later credential/target revision 503; audit readback
material conditional delete including the exact credential hash and excluding last_login; stale target 409; tombstone receipt and exact replay acknowledgement

exact TenantSetting('billing').setting_value CAS; partial merge of supplied fields preserving unseen keys; finite/non-negative/mode validation; concurrent loser 409; confirmed audit rollback effect=none; fresh-session budget consumers observe committed truth

credential_contract.initial_proof: core.auth.verify_password(authorized_password, generated_password_hash) before write; wrong hash is a pre-effect CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH refusal
credential_contract.private_material: id/email/name/role_id/status plus a keyed non-reversible credential_commitment over the exact stored hash
credential_contract.public_projection: id/email/name/role_id/status plus timestamps only; no credential commitment or hash
credential_contract.result_binding: the credential commitment is included in the audit result digest; replay compares the fresh private state to the original result digest
credential_contract.replay_change: changed, malformed or deleted credential after original commit -> committed_unverified 503; no overwrite, no fresh salted hash, no second user
credential_contract.update_delete: user update/delete CAS binds the exact current credential hash and excludes unrelated last_login

durable_ledger.operation_identity: AuditLog.id is the server-owned operation id; supplied ids are prefixed deterministically
durable_ledger.material_binding: operation kind, actor id/role, platform/tenant scope, target type/id, request material digest and result digest
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session on the same engine; target state must still match the result digest or be absent for delete
durable_ledger.replay: same id/same material already_applied; changed material 409; later target/credential revision or audit mismatch 503; lost confirmation effect_unknown 503
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no password hash, token, secret, OTP or SQL parameter stored or returned; credential commitment is keyed and non-reversible

result_states.not_applied: confirmed local commit rollback with no original operation: HTTP 409, verification.effect=none, ADMIN_TRANSACTION_ROLLED_BACK; target and audit absent
result_states.committed_unverified: mutation committed but post-commit audit/target readback failed: HTTP 503, effect=committed, original identity, do_not_repeat
result_states.effect_unknown: lost commit confirmation: HTTP 503, effect=unknown, original operation identity, do_not_repeat, no exception SQL/parameters
result_states.conflict: unique constraint, stale target or changed operation material: typed 409; refresh the record
result_states.already_applied: same operation id/same material: verified original acknowledgement, no second effect

consumers.role_permissions: AdminRole.permissions is consumed by the admin role responses; there is no in-process AdminRole permission cache. A fresh-session role GET observes committed permissions.
consumers.budget: BudgetEnforcementService._get_enforcement_mode, SpendAggregationService._budget_limit_from_setting, and the budget GET/PUT routes consume TenantSetting('billing'). The override writer uses the same document; exact-value CAS preserves unseen keys.
consumers.parallel_writers: update_admin_last_login, role/user CRUD, budget override, and other TenantSetting keys; last_login is excluded from user material so the login writer wins without loss; role delete uses NOT EXISTS plus the real FK; budget CAS binds the exact setting document.

response_contract.verified: existing success shape plus additive verification/operation_id/audit_id
response_contract.conflict: 409 typed conflict; refresh the changed record
response_contract.rollback: confirmed local rollback is typed not_applied 409 with verification.effect=none
response_contract.uncertain: 503 with original operation/audit/target identities and do_not_repeat
response_contract.refused: existing 403/404/422 refusal shape with zero mutation
response_contract.credential: safe public projection only; private verifier commitment never returned
